posts.name: Lord Flash Fire
posts.cooked:
Kay. Why?

posts.name: Dandolo
posts.cooked:
Just my personal favorite, though I'm always torn between that and gen. 1 because I was the right age for gen. 1 when it hit.  My sister is the biggest Pokemon fan I know and she was the right age for gen. 3 when that hit so that probably has a lot to do with it. Gen. 4 definitely brought a lot of great stuff too but by the time it came out I was losing interest.

Also, yeah I went with the 1 character answer as a friendly joke.

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
I think most people who played have a prefferance to the gen that was current at the time that they were in the 9-13 age range, since I think that's the big target audience for the actual games. Of course, there are exceptions. I quite like Pokemon Black/White, and I was way past target audience range by then.

For my big favorite, that would be Gen 2. There were plenty of pokemon where you could catch most of the current pokedex without too greatly relying on another game, and there wasn't an obsene number of pokemon just yet.

posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I have always been too old to be the target age range for any generation (currently 37, so I was 16-ish when Red/Blue released).

I played up to Diamond/Pearl and I love me some Pokemon Go but I don't have a favourite generation. Favourite Pokemon, yep. But every generation has at least a couple of mons that I think are ridiculous and stupid so I can't say any gen is better than the others.

posts.name: Etheria
posts.cooked: Gotta be Gen 1 for me. I am one of the purists that got into it at the beggining, found gen 2 facinating and then quickly got annoyed with how fast other mon came out and wanted them to get off my lawn.
